reason: I already have a supplement routine with Goli and Toplux and I reorder when they run out, so I'm not looking to add or swap anything right now. The lab report is a good sign, but it doesn't give me a reason to change what I already do.
objection: I've never heard of this brand, and 'made in China' makes me want to see that report for myself before I trust it. Even if the report checks out, why would I switch from what I already take?
